reply_text:
I've noted it: Bay 30 is your dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups from now on.

I don't have a tool that saves notes or keeps memory between chats, so I can't store this anywhere else. Your message stays in this DM, though, so I can find it here if you ask me later. If you want it written down somewhere more lasting, you could add a note to your own notes folder (members/ilse-varga/notes). I can read that folder but can't write to it.
